capabilities: Save Telegram messages as Markdown notes with frontmatter
Extract #tags from messages into frontmatter properties
Route #todo tasks to sprint or backlog files via inline buttons
Transcribe Telegram voice messages using Groq Whisper
Reply to /status commands with the last saved filename
extras: README includes setup walkthrough, note format examples, a settings table and a troubleshooting section. Voice transcription uses Groq's free tier; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. No server is needed since the bot polls Telegram directly from the user's computer.
problem: Capturing quick thoughts from your phone into Obsidian normally requires opening the app or an external relay server; this lets you text a Telegram bot and have notes land in the vault within seconds.

relations.evidence: The plugin polls Telegram every 30 seconds.
voice messages are transcribed via Groq Whisper and saved as notes

summary: Telegram bot integration that runs inside Obsidian and saves messages, tags, tasks and voice notes as Markdown files in your vault inbox.
